tok 1.0 "Loan approval"

pool bank "Bank"
  lane customer "Customer"
    start started "Loan request needed"
    task request "Submit the loan request"
    task feedback "Receive the feedback"
    end done "Customer informed"
  lane assessor "Risk assessment service"
    service assess "Assess the request" type="assess"
    xor decide "Assessment result?"
    task approve "Approve the loan"
    task deny "Deny the loan"
    xor merge
  lane approverlane "Approver service"
    service review "Review the request" type="review"

flow started -> request -> assess -> decide
flow decide -> approve "small loan, low risk"
flow decide -> deny "high risk"
flow decide -> review "further review or 10,000 or more" default
flow approve -> merge
flow deny -> merge
flow review -> merge
flow merge -> feedback -> done
